items.description:
Wire Worx Manufacturers has made wire and mesh display products since 1997, starting out producing wire toy cars before growing into a full range of wire and mesh display stands and fixtures. The business manufactures from its Koedoespoort Industrial base, supplying stationery, arts and craft, and hardware retailers that need point-of-sale display units for small products.

Rather than selling directly to the public, Wire Worx Manufacturers works as a behind-the-scenes supplier to retail chains, producing the wire racks, hooks and mesh stands that hold merchandise on shop floors across these sectors. Its long history in the trade, dating back almost three decades, has given it an established base of retail customers who return for display fittings as their stores expand or refresh. Based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, the company serves retailers nationwide needing durable wire and mesh display manufacturing.

Wires And Wifi was founded in 2016 to meet a gap for reliable, affordable IT support among individuals and small to medium businesses, growing from an online computer and networking business into a broader service provider. Its core services cover networking solutions, computer and laptop sales and repair, printer sales and repair, CCTV installation, and website development and hosting.

The company positions itself against impersonal call-centre support, offering a personalised, hands-on approach so customers get fast help when something urgent comes up rather than being passed between departments. For small business owners, it also helps implement cost-effective systems such as online quotations, appointment management and point-of-sale solutions that might otherwise feel out of reach. Trading from Koorsboom Avenue in Heuweloord, Centurion, and open weekdays with Saturday morning hours, Wires And Wifi serves home users and small businesses across the area needing practical, affordable IT support.

wkinc, trading as WK Attorneys, is a law firm in Doornpoort, Pretoria, covering ante-nuptial contracts, labour law and CCMA representation, wills and estate administration, divorce, contract drafting, corporate services, debt collection and rent interdicts, and conveyancing. That breadth lets the firm act for both individuals managing personal legal matters and businesses needing ongoing commercial and labour support.

Its labour law work includes representing both employees and employers, extending to conducting disciplinary hearings and assisting with CCMA disputes rather than only advising from the sidelines. On the estate planning side, the firm emphasises that planning starts while a client is still living, then carries out the legal formalities of registering and administering an estate once a family member has passed away. Based in Doornpoort, wkinc serves clients across Pretoria North who want one firm for family, labour, estate and commercial legal needs.

WOW Marketing Agency is a remote-first creative agency based in Pretoria, with additional offices in the Garden Route and London, offering branding, website design and development, graphic design, and digital marketing services. Its photography and videography work extends into specialised areas such as food photography and styling, giving clients more than a generic marketing package.

The agency also handles magazine design, photo editing and retouching, and editorial design, work that suits clients needing polished, print-ready content alongside their digital presence. Its remote-first structure, spanning offices on three continents, lets the agency draw on international design perspective while still working with South African clients from its Pretoria base in The Wilds. WOW Marketing Agency serves businesses across Pretoria and beyond that want a single creative partner for branding, photography and website work rather than separate specialists for each.

Wrap Your Brand is a Kilner Park creative studio offering vehicle branding and wraps, from partial branding through to full vehicle wraps that turn a fleet into a moving advertisement. Alongside vehicle work, the studio produces indoor and outdoor signage and banners, and promotional products and branded merchandise for clients wanting giveaways that keep their brand in customers' hands.

Its digital marketing arm covers website design and social media management, and the studio also develops corporate identity work including logo design, stationery and marketing materials that tie a brand together across every touchpoint. That combination of physical branding, print and digital services lets Wrap Your Brand take a client's visual identity from a logo on a vehicle through to a consistent online presence. Based in Kilner Park, Pretoria, the studio serves businesses wanting one supplier for both their physical and digital branding needs.

Xakwa Holdings is a black-owned, diversified investment company focused on strategic investments in mining, agriculture, petroleum, property and financial services. Its mining interests span a range of commodities including limestone, chrome, platinum, gold, diamonds and coal, run alongside exploration projects and a broader mineral portfolio from its Park Lane West office in Waterkloof Glen.

Community development runs through the Xakwa Foundation, which has supported projects such as a grocery drive for a Delmas school, sponsorship of a Pretoria school's soccer and netball teams at a national winter sports festival, and furniture, cookware and equipment for an early learning centre in Ga Luka. Open on weekdays, Xakwa Holdings combines its commodity investments with these community partnerships, positioning itself as a mining and investment group that channels part of its activity back into the communities where it operates.

Xaro is a CETA-accredited mining training provider delivering programmes in Dangerous Goods handling, Working at Heights, forklift certification, overhead crane operation and lifting equipment training, alongside First Aid, environmental awareness, hazmat handling and rigging. Its instructors combine decades of mining industry experience with hands-on, real-world training scenarios rather than classroom theory alone.

Every course is aligned with South African mining regulations, and the accredited certifications it issues are recognised by mining operations that need compliant, trained staff before they can be deployed on site. Based in Erasmuskloof and open weekdays with Saturday morning hours, Xaro serves the mining industry nationwide, giving operators a single accredited training partner for the full range of safety and equipment certifications their workforce needs to stay compliant.

XPest Pest Control Services has operated across Gauteng since 1986, with qualified, registered technicians specialising in the eradication of ant, cockroach, rat and termite infestations from residential, commercial and industrial premises. Termite treatments come with a five-year service guarantee, and the company offers STERIFOG microbial disinfection fogging alongside wood-destroying-insect clearance certificates for property sales and transfers.

Its rodent treatment programmes are run to full HACCP food-safety standards with complete audit documentation, making the company a fit for food-handling premises as well as ordinary homes and offices. From its Dorandia head office, XPest runs teams across Gauteng, including Alberton, Bedfordview, Benoni, Bryanston, Centurion, Fourways, Johannesburg, Kempton Park, Midrand, Randburg and Sandton, giving it reach well beyond the Pretoria area for clients needing a long-established, HACCP-compliant pest control provider.

Yellohost is a web hosting provider based in Erasmia offering shared hosting plans aimed at individuals, small businesses and corporate clients. Plans include a free website builder for customers without their own site yet, SSD storage for faster load times, free SSL certificates for secure browsing, and free email accounts bundled with cPanel for managing a site.

That combination lets a small business get a website, email and hosting running from a single provider rather than piecing services together from several suppliers. Based in Erasmia, Pretoria, Yellohost serves customers across South Africa looking for straightforward, locally based web hosting rather than a large international host with less personal support. The free-tools approach, bundling a builder and SSL with hosting, is aimed particularly at businesses setting up their first website.

A and H Electronics Solutions is a security systems installer in Eersterust providing CCTV installation, alarm systems, electric fencing, intercom systems, gate automation and remote monitoring for residential and commercial clients. The company also fits palisade steel fencing and offers a guarding division alongside its electronic security installations, giving clients a physical and monitored security option from one installer.

Jobs are carried out by the company's own technicians, with same-day service available and free quotations provided before work begins, and ongoing maintenance keeps installed systems running after the initial fit. The business has built a five-star Google rating from its completed installations across Pretoria. Based in Eersterust, A and H Electronics Solutions serves homes and businesses across the area needing CCTV, fencing, gate automation and alarm systems installed and maintained by a single local provider.

ABC Hansen Africa is an agricultural equipment supplier based in Samcor Park, specialising in grain storage and handling systems, milling solutions, and oil-seed and oil-expelling equipment for the grain value chain. The company has manufactured and distributed this processing equipment since 1995, covering everything from silo layouts and grain handling to feed mills and forage and harvesting equipment.

Its range extends to orchard and timber equipment, spares and engines, and equipment rentals for customers who need machinery for a season rather than buying outright, and the company publishes free guides such as a silo project planning e-book to support customers through equipment decisions. ABC Hansen Africa has also recently opened a branch in Mossel Bay to extend its reach into the Western Cape. Based in Samcor Park, Pretoria, the company serves grain and feed processing businesses across South Africa.

AdminOnline, a product of Jalia Technologies, is a cloud-based management system that helps small businesses and service providers such as sports coaches, arts instructors and tutors handle invoicing, communication and day-to-day administration. The platform is used by more than 26,000 registered families, giving it a proven base of users managing bookings and payments through the system rather than spreadsheets or paper records.

AdminOnline offers a free trial for businesses wanting to test the system before committing, positioning it as an accessible alternative to more complex enterprise administration software built for larger organisations. Based in Southdowns, Centurion, the platform serves individual service providers and small training or coaching businesses across South Africa who need to manage client billing and communication without hiring dedicated admin staff.

Allair is an air-conditioning and refrigeration company established in 1994 and based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, supplying and installing air conditioners, heat pumps, cold rooms and freezer rooms for residential, commercial and industrial clients. The company serves customers across Gauteng and into neighbouring provinces, giving it reach beyond a single-suburb installer.

Alongside installation work, Allair stocks aircon and refrigeration spares, including compressors and replacement parts for appliances such as washing machines and microwaves, letting technicians and customers source components without waiting on imported parts. With more than three decades in the industry and additional branches including one in Boksburg, Allair gives Centurion customers a long-established option for both new air conditioning and refrigeration installations and the ongoing parts supply that keeps older systems running.

ALP Africa (Pty) Ltd, trading from Rosslyn since 2008 and formerly known as Glengyn (Pty) Ltd, manufactures and exports industrial rubber and plastic extrusions and moulded components as part of the global ALP Group, a polymer and rubber technology business with more than four decades of expertise. Its product range includes EPDM profiles, silicone gel pads, and PVC, TPE, TPO, TPR and ABS products, along with EPDM mats, colour granules and UV-resistant shower seals.

Having acquired Tensile Rubber Extrusions in 2014, the company expanded its local manufacturing capacity to support both South African and export customers across industries such as automotive and construction. ALP Africa holds Level 2 B-BBEE contributor status, and from its Akasia base supplies seals, profiles and extrusions to manufacturers who need durable, performance-rated rubber and plastic components rather than generic off-the-shelf parts.

Amandla Pumps is a South African manufacturer of industrial submersible, waste-water and slurry pumps, established in 2002 by a team focused on keeping pace with new pump technology and industry standards. The company designs and manufactures its Jenny J-Series and Varkie S-Series pump ranges specifically for heavy industrial and mining applications rather than adapting consumer pump designs.

Its Varkie S40 model, for example, runs on a 4kW three-phase motor and is built to handle solids up to 45mm, reflecting the rugged specification needed for mining and industrial waste-water work. Because the pumps are designed and manufactured in South Africa, Amandla Pumps can supply both the local and export market without relying on imported stock. Based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, the company serves mining and industrial clients across South Africa needing submersible and slurry pumps built for demanding local conditions.

Amax Electronics is a security technology company in Sinoville with more than 22 years in the field, providing access control, CCTV surveillance, electric fencing and networking as an integrated, single-team solution rather than separate vendor-supplied pieces. Every installation starts with a site risk assessment rather than a standard product catalogue, so gated communities and businesses get a system engineered around their specific risk rather than a one-size security package.

The company monitors and supports installed systems around the clock, and keeps design, supply, installation and support in-house to avoid the finger-pointing that can happen between separate security vendors. Its wider AMAX group includes in-house financing to soften the upfront cost of a system, and a steel fabrication division producing gates, cages and brackets for sites that need custom security structures. Amax Electronics serves gated communities and businesses across Gauteng from its Sinoville base.

Arcadia Hotel Pretoria is a three-star business hotel at the foot of the Union Buildings in Arcadia, forming part of the Arcadia Shopping Centre complex. Guests have access to a fitness centre, private parking and a restaurant, with a 24-hour front desk and free WiFi covering the practical needs of both business and leisure travellers.

Its position within the shopping centre means guests can step out for shopping, food or other amenities without needing to drive anywhere, while still being close enough to walk to the Union Buildings and surrounding government precinct. As a three-star property, Arcadia Hotel Pretoria positions itself as straightforward, good-value accommodation rather than a luxury stay, suiting visitors on business trips to the nearby government and office districts as well as tourists wanting to be near central Pretoria's landmarks.

Aroma Coffee Roastery is a single-origin coffee roastery established in 2010 in The Village shopping complex in Hazelwood, Pretoria, roasting and packing its coffee within 24 hours so customers get freshly roasted beans rather than stock that has sat on a shelf. The Hazelwood branch is one of five Aroma locations across Pretoria and Johannesburg, and also sells roasted and unroasted beans, along with honey and granola, for customers who want to brew at home.

On site, the menu covers coffee, gelato, brownies, cheesecake and waffles for dine-in, takeout or delivery, and the venue also caters for private functions. Trading from Firwood Avenue in Hazelwood, Aroma Coffee Roastery serves customers across the area looking for freshly roasted, single-origin coffee alongside a casual all-day menu rather than a standard chain coffee shop.

Artiflex Engineering is an automation engineering company established in February 2004 and headquartered in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, with additional offices in Gqeberha, Cape Town and Bloemfontein. The company builds turnkey systems by integrating components from different vendors, covering PLC and SCADA systems development, MCC manufacturing, telemetry, and energy monitoring and solar system integration.

Its project experience spans water, wastewater and various other automation applications, and the company emphasises long-term client relationships, noting that its very first client remains one of its valued clients today. Rather than offering generic automation packages, Artiflex positions itself around client-specific solutions built through strategic alliances and specialised in-house expertise. From its Lyttelton Manor head office, Artiflex Engineering serves industrial and municipal clients across South Africa needing integrated automation, control and energy-monitoring systems built around their particular plant or process.

As-Built Laser Scanning is a 3D laser scanning and modelling company in Shere, Pretoria East, established in 2018 and now with more than 187 completed projects. The company converts point-cloud scans into detailed 3D CAD models, 3D mesh models and 2D as-built drawings for facilities managers, architects, engineers and construction professionals across South Africa.

For clients who prefer to handle their own post-production, As-Built Laser Scanning can also supply registered point clouds directly rather than only finished models, giving design teams flexibility in how they use the scan data. The company holds Level 4 B-BBEE compliance and keeps its trade documentation, including public liability insurance and safety training certificates, up to date. Based in Lombardy Business Park in Shere, As-Built Laser Scanning serves clients needing accurate as-built documentation of existing buildings and structures.

Auto Pedigree Pretoria Central is a used-car dealership in Arcadia, part of a South African brand with more than 35 years in the industry. The dealership stocks around 3,000 used vehicles at any time, each put through a 116-point mechanical and electrical inspection before being offered for sale, giving buyers a degree of assurance not always available from private used-car sales.

That inspection process covers both mechanical condition and electrical systems, aiming to catch faults before a vehicle reaches the showroom floor rather than leaving buyers to discover problems after purchase. Open six days a week, with Saturday morning hours and closed Sundays, Auto Pedigree Pretoria Central serves buyers across Pretoria looking for a used vehicle from an established, inspection-backed dealer network rather than an unverified private sale.

Automould is a technical plastics injection moulding manufacturer for the motor industry, established in 1984 and now part of the METAIR group via Smiths Plastics. The company operates an IATF 16949:2016-certified Pretoria plant, the automotive industry's own quality management standard, producing injection-moulded and painted components and sub-assemblies for vehicle manufacturers and their supply chains.

Its plant also holds ISO 45001 occupational health and safety certification and ISO 14001 environmental management certification, reflecting a manufacturing operation built to meet the compliance expectations of major automotive customers rather than a smaller aftermarket supplier. Based in The Willows, Pretoria, Automould serves motor industry clients needing injection-moulded and painted plastic components produced to internationally recognised automotive quality and safety standards.

Bazaruto Seafoods Centurion is a fresh seafood shop next to Centurion Mall on South Street, stocking hake, salmon, kingklip, tuna, prawns, crab, mussels, oysters, scallops and calamari. Fresh fish is delivered three times a week and never frozen, giving customers a genuine fresh-seafood counter rather than a freezer aisle in a general supermarket.

That delivery schedule means stock varies through the week depending on what has just come in, which suits customers planning a specific seafood meal around what's freshest rather than expecting the same fixed range every visit. Open seven days a week, including Sunday mornings, Bazaruto Seafoods Centurion trades from its South Street premises in Zwartkop and serves households and caterers across Centurion looking for fresh, never-frozen seafood close to the mall precinct.

Beefcor is a fully integrated beef company based in Rosslyn, founded in 1973 with just 1,000 head of cattle and now marketing up to 70,000 cattle a year. The company supplies meat through a network of branded butcheries and delis across Gauteng, including standalone Beefcor outlets as well as partner stores trading under their own names but stocking Beefcor product.

That scale lets Beefcor supply consistent beef quality to multiple retail points rather than operating as a single local butchery, while still keeping its production base in Rosslyn. The Rosslyn site functions as the company's production and distribution hub behind this retail network rather than as a public-facing shop itself. Beefcor's reach across South Africa, from its roots as a small cattle operation, reflects five decades of growth in the local beef supply chain.

Bene Ba EL Holdings (Pty) Ltd, founded in August 2015 and based in Heatherdale, Pretoria North, is a real estate agency handling property buying, selling and renting for clients across the area. Alongside core estate agency work, the company offers property marketing and management services for owners who want ongoing support after a sale or during a tenancy rather than a one-off transaction.

Its service range also extends beyond property into consulting, general construction and social media marketing, giving the company a broader base than a typical single-service estate agency. That combination suits clients who might need a property managed, a small building project overseen, or their business promoted online, all through one company. Based in Heatherdale, Bene Ba EL Holdings serves property buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords across Pretoria North.

Bentich (Pty) Ltd is an accounting, taxation and consulting firm in Erasmuskloof founded in October 2020 by a husband-and-wife team with a combined 19 years of experience in the field. The firm serves individuals, companies, partnerships, charities and non-profit organisations, giving it a broader client base than firms that focus only on corporate or only on personal tax work.

As a newer firm built on experienced principals rather than a large existing client book, Bentich positions itself around direct, personal service from its founders rather than clients being passed between junior staff. Based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, Bentich (Pty) Ltd serves individuals and organisations across the area needing accounting, tax and consulting support from a small, experienced practice rather than a large impersonal firm.

Bespoke Legal is a Pretoria law firm built specifically for creative and design businesses, helping architects, painters, fashion designers and graphic artists handle the legal side of running a creative practice. Its business law services cover company registration and formation, shareholder agreements, e-commerce policies and management procedures, while its contract law work includes NDAs, service level agreements, CMT agreements, consignment agreements and independent contractor agreements suited to creative industries.

The firm also handles employment and labour law, putting conditions of employment, safety and work-method policies in place and assisting with disciplinary proceedings, and offers straightforward legal consultations for creatives unsure whether they need formal legal help at all. Based in Villieria, Pretoria, Bespoke Legal serves start-up and established creative businesses looking for cost-effective, specialised legal support rather than a general commercial law firm unfamiliar with their industry.

Bidvest Prestige's Pretoria office, based in Samrand Business Park, is a healthcare-focused branch of the national Bidvest Prestige contract cleaning and hygiene group, covering contract cleaning, specialised cleaning and event staffing for clients across the region. Its service range also includes training through its Edge Training division, mobile toilet hire for events and sites without permanent facilities, and supply of healthcare workers for medical and care environments.

The branch draws on the wider Bidvest Prestige group's additional services, including auto care and robotics cleaning, giving commercial, retail, healthcare and industrial clients access to a broader cleaning and hygiene offering than a single-service contractor. Based in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, Bidvest Prestige Pretoria serves organisations across the region that need outsourced cleaning, staffing or hygiene services handled by an established national group with local delivery.

Big Brand Productions is a Pretoria signage and large-format printing company on Selati Street in Ashlea Gardens, established in 2009 as part of the Marketing Support Services Group, which has more than 28 years of combined experience in advertising, design and print. The company produces banners, vehicle signage, illuminated signs and lightboxes, graphic panels and shopfront window graphics, along with eco-friendly signage options for clients wanting a lower environmental impact.

Its range extends to signage rentals for single events and laser cutting for custom branding projects, and the company also offers broader branding management services beyond signage alone. Open six days a week, Big Brand Productions serves businesses across Gauteng and Southern Africa needing signage produced to a consistent standard from consultation through to installation.

Big Foot Outdoor Gear is a small Koedoespoort business making custom canvas products and repairs for the outdoor and camping industry, alongside stainless steel braai equipment. What began around the Covid period as one person making utility bags in a spare room has grown, through word of mouth, into a workshop also producing awnings, roof top tents and vehicle drawer systems alongside its original canvas work.

Its "Sakki" utility bags, inspired by the kind of bag thrown in the back of a bakkie or strapped to a roof rack, sit alongside the business's shower trays, vanity organisers and visor organisers among its best-selling items, and the workshop also takes on custom projects for campers with specific gear or storage needs. Trading from Eland Street in Koedoespoort, open weekday mornings to afternoons, it serves campers and overlanders across Pretoria.

Bladkon (Pty) Ltd, established in 1982, specialises in the concrete construction of suspended floor and roof slabs for residential projects, providing in-house structural engineering design alongside the physical construction work. That combination lets the company move from engineering drawings to poured concrete without handing design off to a separate consultant partway through a project.

The company also handles reinforcement cutting and bending in-house, and works alongside partner companies Eastern Readymix and ERM Pumping Services to secure ready-mix concrete supply and pumping for each pour. Based on Graham Road in Shere, Bladkon serves residential builders and developers across Pretoria East who need suspended slab construction backed by in-house engineering rather than coordinating separate design, reinforcement and pumping suppliers themselves.

BosBoma is a countryside event venue in Kameeldrift East, Pretoria, hosting weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, corporate functions and other private celebrations with exclusive single-event-per-day use. Couples and hosts can choose between an open-air boma setting for dining and dancing under the stars, or a bush chapel ceremony surrounded by indigenous trees, accommodating roughly 10 to 120 guests depending on the event.

The venue serves homemade cuisine with no corkage fee, letting guests bring their own drinks rather than paying venue mark-ups, and evenings often wind down around copper-lit campfires for a more informal close to the celebration. BosBoma's team also provides tailored planning guidance from the first site visit through to the event itself. Based on Plot 92 in Kameeldrift East, Roodeplaat, BosBoma gives Pretoria couples and hosts a private bushveld setting for events of various sizes.

Boshoff & Smith Attorneys is a boutique law firm operating from Southdowns Ridge Office Park in Irene, Centurion, with an additional office in Johannesburg. The firm specialises in family law, deceased estates, commercial law, civil litigation, and wills and trusts, giving it a practice that covers both personal and commercial legal needs.

As a boutique rather than a large corporate firm, Boshoff & Smith positions itself around personalised legal solutions and clear communication, aiming to resolve matters efficiently rather than letting cases drag on. Its multi-city presence across Pretoria and Johannesburg lets it serve clients who need representation or coordination in both centres without engaging two separate firms. Based in Irene, Centurion, Boshoff & Smith Attorneys serves individuals and businesses across the Pretoria and Johannesburg areas needing family, estate, commercial or civil litigation legal services.

Branch-Out Tree Farms is an indigenous tree nursery east of Pretoria, just off the old Bronkhorstspruit Road near the N4 toward eMalahleni, stocking roughly 24,000 trees ranging from under a metre to more than two metres tall in 10, 20, 40 and 100 litre bags. Most of the trees are indigenous to South Africa, and the nursery serves both individual buyers and landscaping and nursery professionals buying at volume.

Stock is updated weekly, and only trees on the current list are available, so buyers are encouraged to check before travelling out to the farm or sending an enquiry. Payment can be made by card, cash or bank transfer, but no tree leaves the farm until it has been paid for in full. Open daily except Sundays and public holidays, Branch-Out Tree Farms gives landscapers and tree buyers direct access to a large indigenous tree stock at farm-gate prices.

Bressan Civils is a Black Woman Owned, BBBEE Level 1 civil engineering company based in Heatherdale, Pretoria, that grew out of an earlier business specialising in multi-discipline civils projects. Its project management work covers project administration, site drawings and site quantity surveying, while its civils division handles site builds and upgrades, tower erection, access road construction and the rigging of lattice structures.

On the maintenance side, the company looks after existing telecoms and network sites, including radio frequency and general network maintenance, keeping infrastructure operational after the initial build. Bressan Civils also offers SHEQ consulting, covering safety, health, environmental and quality management for clients who need that expertise alongside the physical construction work. Based in Heatherdale, Bressan Civils serves telecoms, network and civil infrastructure clients across Pretoria needing both construction and ongoing site maintenance from one company.

British Xabhaya is a Pretoria-based utility management company with more than ten years of experience, providing prepaid electricity and water meter supply, installation, and online token vending for more than fifty utility customers. Its meter-to-cash systems let landlords, property managers and sectional title schemes bill residents accurately for what they use rather than estimating consumption.

Beyond basic metering, the company carries out energy and water audits and leak detection, helping property owners identify where consumption or losses are higher than expected before installing new meters. Token purchases are available online around the clock through the company's app and website, cutting out queues at a physical vending point. Open daily into the evening, British Xabhaya serves residential, commercial and sectional title properties across Pretoria needing prepaid utility infrastructure and the ongoing vending and audit support that goes with it.

Bruni Physiotherapy in Rietondale is run by a husband-and-wife team of physiotherapists, both trained at the University of Pretoria, who each spent a decade working at the High Performance Centre before opening their own practice. That background shows in the practice's sports focus, treating rowing, running, athletics, triathlon, swimming, soccer, tennis, rugby and cricket injuries alongside more general diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation work.

One half of the team has worked courtside at events including the Commonwealth Games, the Olympics and the Fed Cup, while the other has served as physiotherapist to the National Rowing Squad and has a particular interest in dry needling and cruciate ligament rehabilitation. The practice also runs yoga and Pilates classes for patients building strength and flexibility alongside their rehabilitation. Based on Soutpansberg Road in Rietondale, Bruni Physiotherapy serves patients across Pretoria with sports and general physiotherapy needs.

Business Plan Now sells ready-made, industry-specific business plan templates and custom business plans for South African entrepreneurs, starting from R200 and including five-year financial forecasts. The company says it has assisted more than 3,900 entrepreneurs since 2019, working through a simple process of choosing a plan, paying, downloading it, and then updating only the personal and business details indicated in the document.

For entrepreneurs who need funding rather than just a plan, the company operates as a registered credit broker through its sister company, Business Finance Now, introducing clients to a panel of lenders, equity funds and grant agencies rather than lending directly itself. Based in Ashley Gardens, Pretoria, Business Plan Now serves start-up entrepreneurs across South Africa who want a fast, affordable business plan and, where needed, an introduction to potential funders.

Business Synergy is a Centurion-based training technology company that builds Learning Management System and Learner Content Management System software for organisations running formal training programmes. Its platform is paired with a business intelligence and reporting server, aimed at reducing the administrative costs and improving the compliance reporting that training providers otherwise have to manage manually.

The company positions its software as a response to the day-to-day frustrations training providers face with cost control, data consistency, SETA requirements and keeping clients and learners properly informed, rather than a generic off-the-shelf LMS. Based in Raslouw, Centurion, Business Synergy serves training and education organisations across South Africa that need a scalable system for managing learners, content and compliance reporting rather than tracking training manually.

Buzuci, based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, is a printing, gifts, clothing and branding business offering laser engraving, heat transfer, pad printing, sublimation and textile printing for corporate gifts and custom apparel. That range of printing methods lets the business handle different materials and finishes, from fabric to hard surfaces, under one roof rather than outsourcing specialised techniques.

Alongside its printing and branding work, Buzuci also produces foam and upholstery products, a less common addition for a printing business that suggests broader workshop capability beyond standard branding jobs. Based in Lyttelton Manor, Buzuci serves businesses and individuals across Centurion looking for custom corporate gifts, branded apparel or printed promotional items from a single local supplier rather than separate specialists for each technique.

Buzz Group is a Hatfield-based technology company operating across three areas: IT and AI services covering hardware, software, backups and cybersecurity; solar power systems including panels, inverters and battery storage; and home and business automation covering lighting, security, climate and access control. The company positions this combination as future-proofing a property, rather than treating IT, solar and automation as separate purchases from different suppliers.

Its solar division is built to reduce electricity costs and improve energy independence during outages, while its automation systems aim to improve comfort, efficiency and security through integrated rather than standalone smart-home devices. Based in Hatfield, Pretoria, Buzz Group serves homes and businesses across the city wanting IT support, solar power and smart automation handled by one technology partner rather than three separate specialists.

BVi Consulting Engineers Pretoria is the head office of the BVi Group, a multi-disciplinary engineering firm established in 1967 that has grown from traditional civil, structural, electrical and mechanical consulting into a broader range of services. Its structural, electrical building and reticulation, and mechanical building teams handle the core building-services work, while separate groups cover electrical transmission and distribution and civil engineering projects of varying scale.

The firm also works in water engineering for domestic, mining and agricultural clients, transportation projects, turnkey project management, and mining, industrial and EPCM work across the full project life cycle. BVi is a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor with more than 300 professionals on staff, and operates a B-BBEE employee trust as part of its transformation programme. Based in Waterkloof Glen, BVi Consulting Engineers Pretoria serves public and private clients across South Africa needing multi-disciplinary engineering consulting.

The Capital City Business Chamber (CCBC) is a business chamber based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, that supports business growth in the Tshwane region through networking events, a member business directory, and facilitating collaboration between government, business and the community. Regular events include the CCBC Annual Prestige Gala Dinner and an Executive Golf Day, alongside smaller networking events throughout the year.

The chamber also runs a programme supporting micro businesses, giving members of micro business forums their own online profiles to help them reach customers and other businesses. Its work extends into local economic development through Improvement Districts, including the Rosslyn Improvement District and the West Improvement District, which focus on upgrading and promoting those specific business areas. Based in Rosslyn, the CCBC serves businesses across Tshwane looking for networking, visibility and a voice in local economic development initiatives.

Capital House Boutique Hotel, also known as The Waterkloof Mansion, is a five-star boutique hotel at 369 Victoria Street in Waterkloof, Pretoria, offering twelve rooms, an outdoor swimming pool and a garden setting within a converted mansion property. Breakfast is included in stays, and free Wi-Fi is available throughout, giving guests the practical comforts of a larger hotel within a much smaller, more personal property.

Its boutique scale means guests get a quieter, more individual stay than a large hotel chain can offer, while the Waterkloof location keeps them close to Pretoria's embassy district and upmarket suburbs. Capital House has built a following among travellers rating it highly on international booking and review platforms. Based in Waterkloof, Pretoria, Capital House Boutique Hotel serves guests wanting five-star boutique accommodation in a residential setting rather than a conventional city-centre hotel.

Car Service City is a vehicle repair and maintenance chain, and this branch in Hennopspark, Centurion offers services including air conditioning, brakes, clutch and gearbox repairs, engine diagnostics and inspections, electrical work, and exhaust and emissions repairs. The branch also handles suspension and steering, tyre fitting and wheel alignment, and windscreen and mirror replacement, covering most routine mechanical needs under one roof.

That range means a customer can bring a vehicle in for anything from a basic service to a more involved mechanical fault without needing to visit a specialist elsewhere, as part of a chain with standardised service offerings across its branches. Trading from Jacaranda Street in Hennopspark, and open weekdays with Saturday morning hours, Car Service City serves motorists across Centurion looking for a general vehicle workshop rather than a brand-specific dealership service centre.

Carany Catering & Hiring, established in 2000, is a Villieria, Pretoria-based caterer known for its food, service and presentation across wedding, corporate, fine-dining and kiddies-party catering. The company's food platters and catering packages are built around attention to detail, and its team of eleven to fifteen staff gives it the capacity to handle events of varying sizes.

Alongside catering, the business runs an equipment hire side covering tableware, silverware, table linen, marquee tents and popcorn machines, letting clients hire both the food and the equipment for an event from one supplier. Open on weekdays, Carany Catering & Hiring trades from Nico Smith Street in Villieria and serves hosts across Pretoria planning anything from a corporate function to a children's party who want catering and event equipment handled together.

Champion Boarding Kennels & Cattery offers short- and long-term boarding for dogs and cats at its premises opposite Roodeplaat Dam, off Moloto Road. The kennels welcome pets of all ages and sizes, giving owners heading away on holiday or needing temporary care a single facility for both dogs and cats rather than separate dog and cat boarding providers.

The facility does set some admission limits, not accepting aggressive dogs or unsterilised dogs over six months old, a policy aimed at keeping the boarding environment safe for all animals on site. Its location opposite Roodeplaat Dam puts it on the northern edge of Pretoria, away from the busier city kennels, which may suit owners looking for a quieter setting for their pets. Champion Boarding Kennels & Cattery serves pet owners across Pretoria needing boarding for a few days or an extended stay.

Cheryl Muller is a certified ActionCOACH business and executive coach based in Irene, Centurion, working with businesses and individuals from start-ups through to executives. Her coaching covers small, medium and large companies, including first-time business owners still learning how to run a company, pay themselves a market-related salary and turn a profit.

Programmes are built around identifying a client's specific challenges and applying practical, results-driven solutions, covering areas such as sales and marketing strategy, leadership development and operational efficiency. As part of the ActionCOACH network, Cheryl Muller also runs quarterly GrowthCLUB planning workshops, giving clients a structured session to set and review business goals beyond their one-on-one coaching sessions. Based in Cornwall Hill Estate, Irene, Cheryl Muller serves entrepreneurs and executives across Centurion and Pretoria wanting hands-on coaching rather than generic business advice.
